mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my home for an interior restoration project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparing your home for an interior restoration project involves decluttering the work areas, protecting valuable items, and making arrangements for pets if necessary. Removing personal belongings, furniture, and wall decor from the restoration zones helps streamline the process and ensures their safety. It's also beneficial to have any necessary permits or approvals in place. Hometelligent Inc. provides a pre-project checklist during the planning phase to guide clients through these preparation steps effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare for interior restoration by decluttering work areas, protecting valuables, and making pet arrangements. Removing personal items helps streamline the process. A pre-project checklist is provided.
